summary.tagline: Explore the dramatic geology of the most north-westerly village on the Scottish mainland.

travel.headline: Geological exploration at Smoo Cave
travel.reservation: Access to the Smoo Cave waterfall chamber via the walkway is free. Guided tours to venture further into the lake chamber require separate on-site check-in and are subject to local water levels; verify availability upon arrival.

days.title: Durness Coastal Geology
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM from Durness village center

stops.name: Smoo Cave
stops.detail: Walk from the car park to view the active waterfall chamber fed by the Allt Smoo stream. Join a tour to explore the deeper lake chamber and learn about the human history of this millions-of-years-old formation.

days.driving: Allow 10 minutes for the walk from the car park; conditions vary based on local weather.
days.note: Wear sensible footwear as the cave environment includes wet surfaces and uneven terrain.

intel.title: Smoo Cave Car Park
intel.text: The main parking area is located directly beside the North Coast 500 route. Access to the cave involves a short walk from this designated zone.

intel.title: Connectivity Gaps
intel.text: Mobile signal in the far north-west can be inconsistent. Verify your route and tour availability before leaving Durness village.

intel.title: Regional Refueling
intel.text: As the most north-westerly village, fuel availability is limited to local stations. Ensure tanks are sufficient for remote coastal driving.

intel.title: Waterfall Chamber Access
intel.text: The walk to the waterfall chamber typically takes 10 minutes. Plan extra time if you intend to join a guided tour deeper into the cave system.

intel.title: Weather Dependency
intel.text: Smoo Cave is an active system fed by a stream. Heavy rain may impact access to certain chambers or the availability of boat-based tours.

plan.arrival: Arrive via the NC500, check in at local Durness accommodation, and proceed to the Smoo Cave car park for immediate geological sightseeing.
plan.vehicle: Suitable for cars and smaller campervans; check NC500 road width restrictions for larger RVs.
plan.goldenHour: Coastal cliffs near Durness offer elevated views, though cave visibility is best during daylight hours.
